parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The two methods — `ReviewRequestServiceTests.shouldRequestReviewAtThreshold` (line 90) and `ReviewRequestServiceTests.actionsAfterReviewDoNotRetrigger` (line 177) — are distinct test cases that verify different behavioural aspects of the review-request service (threshold triggering vs. post-review suppression). A high Jaccard similarity of ~0.82 in test methods is expected when they share the same test subject, fixture setup, and assertion style, not because they are unintentionally duplicated. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and violate the single-responsibility principle for test cases.
